items.verbatim: DEVELOPMENT AND TESTING OF LUCID: A THERAPEUTIC DEVICE FOR BRAIN INJURY FOLLOWING INFANT CARDIAC ARREST - CARDIAC ARREST IN INFANTS IS A MEDICAL EMERGENCY REQUIRING RAPID RESUSCITATION TO RESTORE CIRCULATION. HOWEVER, RESUSCITATION OFTEN RESULTS IN SIGNIFICANT BRAIN INJURY, CAUSED BY ISCHEMIA/REPERF
